forma.circle_move: Move the circle with the mouse: drag the area around it
forma.hint_circle_sub: Drag the area around the circle with the mouse
forma.jpg_note: JPG has no transparency: the background outside the shape will be white
forma.jpg_note_color: JPG has no transparency: the background outside the shape will be {color}
forma.radius_tip:
Corner radius in screenshot pixels, from 0 to half of the shorter side.
You can also drag the handle on the top left corner of the screenshot
forma.size_tip:
Drag the handles to resize the shape, Shift: keep proportions
Move it: drag the area around the shape, with “Select and move” (V) also inside it
forma.tip_off:
Screenshot shape: rounded corners, oval, circle
A click turns on “{name}”, the arrow next to it opens all shapes
forma.tip_on:
Screenshot shape · {name}
A click returns to a rectangle, the arrow next to it opens all shapes
forma.title: Screenshot shape
